data.one_liner: Pure‑Dart LZMA compression library for encoding and decoding byte arrays.
data.what_it_does: Provides lzma.encode to compress a list of bytes and lzma.decode to decompress LZMA data. The implementation is a manual port of the original Java SDK and works on all Dart platforms.
use_when: You need LZMA compression in a pure‑Dart project without native plugins
Cross‑platform code (mobile, web, desktop) must stay in Dart
avoid_when: You need to compress data larger than 4 GB (output limited to 32 bits)
Streaming compression or high‑performance native codecs are required
strengths: Pure Dart implementation – no native build steps
Simple API with just encode/decode functions
weaknesses: Last update was minor; may lack optimizations
